text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoooo!
(Yoo-hoo~~...)

I had come to the mountains with Machikane 
Tannhauser. As for the reason why—

After her debut race, when the 
conversation turned to what was needed to 
achieve the Classic Triple Crown――

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can pull it off the way I 
am now. So, I'm gonna power up big time 
all at once! I'll push myself up to a 
level that can reach the Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Specifically, well... I'd like to be able 
to finish in the top 5—make the board—in 
GⅠ races!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to our training over the last few 
months, your abilities have improved 
tremendously! You even achieved our goal 
of placing in a GⅠ!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So to increase our chances of winning even 
further! I would like to do one final 
training session right here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And so, ta-da!

Written down in the notepad brought out 
was a long list of 'training' scheduled 
for today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Waterfall meditation, high-speed mountain 
climbing... and finally, full-sprint beach 
running!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Unlike our usual routine, there are some 
pretty tough parts where danger lurks if 
you let your guard down, but...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If we can see this through to the end, 
body and soul will shed a layer or two... 
No, five whole layers!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it my all to become stronger! 
Yaar!"

And so, the training began with plenty of 
enthusiasm, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-It's freezing! I give up!

text_block_list.name: Waterfall Meditation Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, well, this time of year is tough. 
Good on you for coming all the way out 
here as a beginner.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Y-You gentlemen as well! It's so cold, yet 
you look so totally unbothered, it's 
amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Waterfall Meditation Club Member B
text_block_list.text: We're used to it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Waterfall Meditation Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit warmer over there in the sun. 
Go get your body used to the water.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Dangk you zo much...!

Even during the next "training," the 
high-speed mountain climb...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Fast, fast, mountain climbing at high 
speed...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *pant, haaah*...!

text_block_list.name: Mountaineering Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
My, as expected of a young horse girl, you 
sure have incredible leg strength~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: T-Thank you so much~ Ehehe.
(Grumble~...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wawa, I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Mountaineering Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. They're handing out tonjiru 
over there. Go grab some if you like.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: A-Are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Mountaineering Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Of course. There are plenty, so please 
don't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yay, awesome~!

And for our final 'training,' how about a 
run along the beach under the sunset...!

text_block_list.name: Girls' Volleyball Club Captain
text_block_list.text: Ina High~, Fight-oh, fight-oh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, you see, while I was running 
alone, I happened to bump into the 
volleyball team~."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I was feeling lonely, so I came to hang 
out with you! Ehehe~

text_block_list.name: Girls' Volleyball Club Member
text_block_list.text: Captain, Tannhauser-chan is running late~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, shoot! Catch you later, then!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ina High~, Fight-oh, fight-oh!

text_block_list.name: Girls' Volleyball Club
text_block_list.text: Fight, oh!

The training I had in mind was supposed to 
be much tougher, but...

She could blend into any circle in no time 
at all— it was a day that truly showed 
that side of her personality.

All in all... we managed to get results in 
the GⅠ race as well. At this rate, aiming 
for the Triple Crown shouldn't be an 
issue. Which means――

Our next target is finally the Satsuki 
Sho! I want us to buckle down and prepare 
for it!
